mapper.insert: INSERT INTO integration_outbox (tenant_id, provider, binding_id, workitem_id, event_type, payload_json, operation_key, lock_version, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, last_error) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{provider}, #{bindingId}, #{workitemId}, #{eventType}, #{payloadJson}, #{operationKey}, #{lockVersion}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{lastError})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM integration_outbox WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE integration_outbox SET status = 'SENDING', lock_version = lock_version + 1, last_error = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND lock_version = #{expectedLockVersion} AND (status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'FAILED' AND next_retry_at <= NOW(3)))
UPDATE integration_outbox SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', last_error = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND lock_version = #{lockVersion} AND status IN ('SENDING', 'UNKNOWN')
UPDATE integration_outbox SET status = 'UNKNOWN', last_error = #{lastError}, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND lock_version = #{lockVersion} AND status IN ('SENDING', 'UNKNOWN')

UPDATE integration_outbox SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, next_retry_at =
DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL LEAST(300, POW(2, LEAST(retry_count + 1, 9))) SECOND)
NULL
WHERE id = #{id} AND lock_version = #{lockVersion} AND status = 'SENDING'
UPDATE integration_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', last_error = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND lock_version = #{lockVersion} AND status = 'UNKNOWN'

UPDATE integration_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', lock_version = lock_version + 1, retry_count = 0, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND lock_version = #{expectedLockVersion} AND (status = 'UNKNOWN' OR (status = 'FAILED' AND next_retry_at IS NULL))

UPDATE integration_outbox SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', lock_version = lock_version + 1, last_error = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND lock_version = #{expectedLockVersion} AND (status = 'UNKNOWN' OR (status = 'FAILED' AND next_retry_at IS NULL))
